name: Poe
summary: Quora's chat platform giving access to many third-party AI models and user-made bots in one app.
description: Poe is a chat platform operated by Quora that gives access to models from several providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and others, from one interface. Users can chat privately or in group chats, switch models within a conversation and use thousands of community-created bots. Developers can also publish their own bots.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Poe's help center says subscribers can send far more messages than free users, and can generate more images, video and audio.

howToUse.title: Open Poe
howToUse.description: Open Poe, the chat platform operated by Quora, and start a conversation in one interface.

howToUse.title: Switch models from several providers
howToUse.description: Switch models within the conversation. Poe gives access to models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI.

howToUse.title: Chat privately, in a group, or with bots
howToUse.description: Chat privately or in group chats, and use thousands of community-created bots. Developers publish their own bots from the same interface.

features_fr: La plateforme de chat de Quora donnant accès à de nombreux modèles d'IA tiers et à des robots créés par les utilisateurs dans une seule application.
Poe est une plateforme de chat exploitée par Quora qui donne accès aux modèles de plusieurs fournisseurs, dont OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI et autres, à partir d'une seule interface.
Les utilisateurs peuvent discuter en privé ou en groupe, changer de modèle au cours d'une conversation et utiliser des milliers de robots créés par la communauté.
Les développeurs peuvent également publier leurs propres robots.
